notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: SSH client (Apache-2.0 sshj) with password or Ed25519/RSA private-key auth, Trust-On-First-Use host-key verification (fail-closed on key change), a loopback-only SSH tunnel (local port forwarding) to reach server-side services such as Ollama/MCP/OpenCode/Claude/Antigravity over an encrypted channel, and a quick remote command runner — all in Settings → SSH Servers with a credential-free SSH log in Developer Tools. Secrets are stored in an opaque Android-Keystore AES-GCM store (multiline keys and passphrases preserved exactly) and are never backed up. Keeps the MCP client, local model fallback, AI router, document base (RAG), Material 3 dynamic color, in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Developer Tools, session auto-recovery, release & signing, optional server sync, reproducible build + SBOM. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
